# Shortlist memo

Club-conditioned targets (public-data decision support). Full memo template: `reports/shortlist_report.Rmd`.

```{r}
#| echo: false
sl |>
  dplyr::group_by(club_id) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 15) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Club = club_id, Rank = rank, Player = display_name,
    Overall = round(score_overall, 1), Rec = recommendation
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
